items.title: Robots and surge pricing won't save fast food: Robert Irvine
items.summary: World-class chef and entrepreneur, Robert Irvine explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi why dynamic pricing is a little much, and why McDonald's burger-flipping robot and Chipotle's avocado-peeling machine can't replace the one thing that actually keeps customers coming back.

items.title: The business mistake McDonald's and Chipotle keep making: Robert Irvine
items.summary: World-class chef and entrepreneur, Robert Irvine explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi how he helped push through the legislative change that's replacing 50-year-old Army mess halls with campus-style dining

items.title: Uber to Power McDonald's App Deliveries as Partnership Widens
items.summary: Orders placed in the McDonald's app will mainly run through Uber Direct

items.title: McDonald's expands its partnership with Uber
items.summary: The fast-food giant reached a deal to make Uber Technologies its preferred partner on in-app delivery orders in 14 countries, including the U.S. The deal could also open additional features for loyalty members.

items.title: Customers Suing McDonald’s In Chicago Are Not Lovin’ the McRib
items.summary: A federal judge says customers could reasonably expect a sandwich called the McRib to contain actual ribs.

items.title: McDonald’s Looks To Make $20B McDelivery Business ‘More Reliable And More Rewarding’ With Uber
items.summary: Uber COO Andrew Macdonald described the expansion as the companies’ broadest partnership to date, bringing together their delivery and mobility networks to create a more rewarding customer experience.

items.title: McDonald’s and Uber Expand Delivery and Rewards Partnership Across 14 Markets
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) and McDonald’s Corporation (NYSE:MCD) have announced a multi-year expansion of their partnership, introducing additional delivery services and loyalty programme benefits across 14 international markets. The agreement covers the United States, Australia, Belgium, Canada, France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Poland, Portugal, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.
